text:
Sam: FYI noticed p99 on /v1/chat spike in ap-south after route policy tweak last night, p50/p95 unchanged, p99 +180ms
Jin: saw dashboard. is this the fallback reroute that increased cheap-variant weight?
Sam: yes, policy moved fallback 0.1 -> 0.35 at 23:40 UTC (autoscale rollout)
Rosa: traces point to variant-b-quant being overrepresented in p99 and many show kvcache_miss on first chunk
Leo: variant-b-quant has okay median but much heavier tail when cache cold or long sequences >600 tokens
Sam: raw numbers: p99 calc used ~220 samples last hour while p95 had ~9k, so p99 noisy
Jin: combination of actual tail shift + statistical noise. console should show sample_count next to percentile and a low-sample tooltip
Rosa: can we add per-variant percentiles under endpoint breakdown? would make root-cause obvious faster
Leo: immediate ops: rollback fallback weight to 0.1 (Sam), run KV priming on canary (Leo), annotate dashboard with routing change (Jin)
deploy-bot: execute: rollback route ap-south fallback weight -> 0.1 (requested by Sam)
Sam: monitoring now for next 15m, will post incident note if p99 doesn't recover
Jin: UX request: show yellow "p99 unstable" badge when sample_count < 500 with hover text about variance
Rosa: and add a column to route table for "fallback-hit-rate" to correlate latency deltas with routing events
Leo: long term: surface provenance (route weight, fallback rate, kvcache hit-rate, per-variant percentiles) in latency pane
Sam: thanks team. follow-up postmortem will include routing tweak timeline, sample counts, and console improvements
